dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new Iranian safeguards decision, qualifying enrichment-production threshold, weaponization order, detonation or NPT withdrawal appeared. IAEA public news and press pages again returned HTTP 403; reachable UN feeds added no threshold event. Raw 49; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: OilPrice, citing Iran’s Shana agency and the Iranian Oil Terminals Company, reports that Tehran is accelerating safety, fire-detection and reliability work at Kharg Island, which handles about 90% of Iranian oil exports. Windward imagery counted 24 dark tankers in the waiting area on Sunday. This hardens a previously threatened asset but is not a new attack order or resumption of direct strikes. Brent/WTI stood at $85.81/$81.45. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: The National directly reports three Israeli drones struck an apartment building in Nabatieh Al Fawqa, extensive attacks continued on the Ali Al Taher hills and state media reported detonations across several southern towns, with dozens of homes said destroyed. The operations occurred while the pilot-zone scheme was under way; the 4–6 August Rome channel remains scheduled. This is fresh field evidence but double-counts conditions already reflected in the near-ceiling lane. Raw 87; coupled 97

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: The full rolling-day Google/Bing review and reachable NATO pages produced no verified Turkish combat entry, unusual force concentration, qualifying long-range weapons event or official atomic-weapons threshold. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No later attribution or exchange of fire followed the suspected drone movement and searches near Samba and Rajouri reported on 27 July. The 12Z review found no interstate strike or unusual force concentration. Raw 15; coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Ariana News Agency alone relays Taliban-aligned media claims that Afghan aircraft hit Freedom Front positions in Shah Salim, Chitral. The outlet provides no imagery, toll or named official, and neither Kabul nor Pakistan confirmed it; seven exact English/Dari searches found no independent current report. The UNAMA 499-death aggregate remains retrospective. Raw 46; coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP’s new synthesis confirms three recent Russian-origin drones were shot down over Romania, but reports no NATO combat entry or collective response. The separate Caspian strike on the Iranian vessel Anna remains the latest direct Ukraine-Iran linkage. Raw 99; coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP reports Romanian F-16s shot down three drones in as many days starting Friday and that recovered evidence established Russian origin; Bucharest summoned Moscow’s ambassador and expelled a diplomat. Romania says 19 drones have entered its airspace this year. No formal NATO consultation or collective-force decision was announced, so this clarification reinforces rather than reprices the already high lane. Raw 58; coupled 68

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Rolling-day coverage added drills and civil-resilience analysis but no newly verified blockade, expanded live-fire operation, amphibious concentration or direct China-Taiwan clash. The exact clash sanity contract moved only 0.10 point to 6.65%; it remains outside the model. Raw 24; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: The new indexing remained analysis of North Korea’s missile support to Russia and alliance doctrine. South Korean monitoring still has not confirmed the circulated fresh troop-deployment claim; no operational firing, launcher relocation or prohibited detonation appeared. Raw 18; coupled 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The National reports the army says it captured Bara and nearby villages, opening the Khartoum–Kordofan motorway and restricting the RSF route back toward the capital. Gen Mohamed Dagalo answered with a “no more retreat” order after an emergency security meeting; residents described the subsequent drone attack on El Obeid as among the war’s most severe, but no casualty or damage toll was available. The near-ceiling lane holds without double-counting. Raw 94; coupled 94

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: The UN Security Council opened its 10203rd meeting on the Middle East and Palestine on 28 July, but the live page had not yet published a substantive decision at the 12Z cutoff. West Bank raids, settler attacks and settlement legalization remain the governing risk evidence; no implemented durable truce or mass force shift appeared. Raw 92; coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: The rolling-day review produced no new South Sudan-Abyei clash, verified large force movement, transition breakdown or UNISFA posture change. Raw 19; coupled 19

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reachable UN, direct-source and rolling-day results added no fresh M23 territorial capture, mass recruitment announcement, direct Rwanda-DRC clash or verified strategic attack. Raw 56; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: OilPrice, citing Bloomberg vessel tracking, says at least eight empty VLCCs are heading to Sidi Kerir as Saudi crude is rerouted through SUMED; no observable tankers were at Yanbu early Tuesday, likely because ships are switching off transponders. Bab el-Mandeb traffic remained at a multi-month low and Hormuz at a two-month low. This is fresh physical-market detail, not a newly verified strike. Raw 92; coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
